text: Long-closure pages for 14 roads that are closed for months, each with the posted dates and a map.
Road conditions for every state, with what that state's feed showed in September.
Mountain pass pages now draw each alert along the road, and every pass has a printable map sheet.
New camera pages for Tennessee, Texas, Kentucky, Massachusetts, West Virginia and Montana.
Live road alerts for Alberta and Manitoba in the app.
Guides for driving into Canada and back, in English and Quebec French.
